successors.name: British Gold Coast
successors.text: Fanteland round Mankessim, incorporated into the British Gold Coast

ledger.x: January 1868: 'A January 1868 meeting at Mankessim included Fante paramount chiefs and representatives from Twifo and Asen' that 'declared the formation of the Fante Confederation', an independent state; Ghartey IV of Winneba elected first King-President.
1868: after the Dutch attack on Komenda in February 1868 the Confederation 'laid siege' to Elmina, 'but the campaign stalled'.

January 1870: the Dutch-led force 'laid the villages of Komenda, Anoema and Kwassie in ashes' in December 1869 and January 1870, and 'the events marked the end of Dutch involvement in the Gold Coast'.
1873: 'collapsed by 1873 and Fanteland was fully incorporated' into the British Gold Coast.

wars.name: Fante Confederacy siege of Elmina
wars.outcome: The campaign 'stalled'; the Confederacy gained no ground on this page.

certainty.note: No frontier on any page; a circle round Mankessim.
